props.title: Description
props.content:
🌟 Tech Beyond Tech 🌟

Through an engaging panel discussion 💬 and networking opportunities 🌐, we’ll explore the many non-linear journeys into tech 💻. From pivoting into a tech career after a non-tech degree, to thriving in non-technical roles at tech companies, or even applying tech skills in industries outside of tech, our speakers will share how they carved out their unique pathways 🌈.

This event is all about breaking down the myth of a single “right” way into technology, and highlighting the diversity ✨ of careers that intersect with it.

Whether you’re considering a career pivot 💼, curious about where your current degree could take you, or simply want to hear real stories 💡 from people who’ve done it, Tech Beyond Tech will give you the insight and connections to explore new possibilities 💫.

Join us for an evening of conversation, inspiration, and networking with peers and professionals who’ve gone beyond the conventional 🌟. Oh — and did we mention there’ll be free food? 🍙

📆 Date: Thursday, 11 September 2025

⏰ Time: 5:30pm to 7:30pm

📍 Location: Lyle Theatre at Redmond Barry

Bring your questions, your curiosity, and get ready for an engaging evening of learning and discussion!

events.name: Intro to Leetcode

props.title: Description
props.content:
🏷️ Ready to level up your coding game?
Join Women in Tech for an Intro to LeetCode workshop and transform the way you tackle algorithm problems! 🤖

Ever stared at a LeetCode challenge and wondered where to start?
We’ll break down the core problem-solving framework and walk through two classic problems from brute-force to optimized solutions — in Python! 🐍

What’s on the agenda?
🔹 Problem-Solving Framework: How to approach any LeetCode challenge
🔹 Two Sum: Brute-force vs. Hash-map with live demo
🔹 Binary Search: Divide-and-conquer strategy
🔹 Live Coding & Practice: Solve problems together in real time
🔹 Pro Tips: Time/space complexity, debugging tricks, best practices
🔹 Resources & Q&A: Next steps for your algorithm journey

🗓️ Date & Time: Wed 30th April 2025, 6–8 PM
📍 Location: Alan Gilbert Room 101
🔗 Sign up using the link in bio

Bring your curiosity, your laptop, and a problem-solving mindset — let’s crack code together! 💪✨

events.name: WIT x Airwallex API Workshop

props.title: Description
props.content:
🏎️ Rev up your tech skills and explore the power of Airwallex APIs in Global Finance!

Ever wondered how modern apps talk to each other? Or how companies like McLaren move money across borders with just a few clicks?

Join Women in Tech (WIT) and Airwallex for an interactive, beginner-friendly workshop where we break down APIs, their role in software development, and how they power real-world fintech solutions! 🚀


What’s in Store?

🔹 APIs 101 – Learn what APIs are, how they work, and how they drive global fintech innovation. (No prior experience needed!)

🔹 Airwallex API Deep Dive – See how Airwallex’s APIs enable cross-border transactions in a real-world solution for McLaren.

🔹 Live Demo & Hands-on Workshop – Build a simple dashboard like the one McLaren’s finance team uses!

🔹 Meet the Experts – Connect with Airwallex engineers and get insider insights into fintech careers.

🗓️ Date & Time: 10th April 2025, 5-7 PM

📍 Location: McCoy Building L2-208-VIEPS Intensive Room

💡 No coding experience? No problem! This session is designed for all skill levels—just bring your curiosity!

🔗 Register now to secure your spot!
